programme.title: What I Did for Love
programme.desc: Call him a city slicker. Call him a tenderfoot. But don't call him a member of the family yet. Rising L.A. lawyer James White is going home for the holidays with his fiancée, Sadie Ryder, to finally meet her family in rural Pine Gap. After blundering through a bad first impression, James attempts to win over Sadie's lawyer-loathing father Karl by pretending to be a horse-riding, hay-baling, game-hunting, seasoned square dancer. But a pair of worn jeans and a ten-gallon hat don't make a cowboy, and it's going to take more than mere posturing to charm Mr. Ryder...in fact, it just may take a miracle.

programme.title: The King and Queen of Moonlight Bay
programme.desc: 17-year-old Alison embarks on a mission: to find the father who abandoned her family when she was five years old, try to understand the past, and reestablish a relationship with the stranger she has never forgotten.

programme.title: A Place Called Home
programme.desc: Tula Jetters (Ann Margret) is a stubborn widow who still mourns the death of her husband from years ago called "The Captain." She lives alone in a big beautiful home by a lake, but her independence may be threatened by the reality of her diminished vision. She has resisted change, including seeing an eye specialist. Her late husband's niece Billie (Hunter Tylo) and nephew Dave (Sean O'Bryan) have a real estate agency and are now pressuring her to go into assisted living. They have dreams of using her land to make a killing in a big land development. They get a county social worker Jan (Rebecca McFarland) involved in evaluating her independence. Into this mix drops a drifter Henry (Matthew Settle) and his young daughter Cali (Shailene Woodley). Restless Henry becomes a handyman while Cali dreams of having a home here.

programme.title: Back to You and Me
programme.desc: After befriending a patient and then losing her to cancer, Dr. Sydney Ludwick decides to take some long-needed time off to reevaluate her life. Persuaded by a friend to attend her 20th high school reunion, Syd halfheartedly returns to her small hometown where, after years of estrangement, she finally confronts her mother about the past and faces the love she left behind.

programme.title: The Yeltsin Project
programme.desc: Russian political elite hires American consultants to help with President Yeltsin's re-election campaign when his approval rating is down to single digits.

programme.title: The Devil's Whore
programme.desc: After Angelica Fanshawe's country noble mother chooses the Catholic faith over the Anglican law of England, her daughter becomes a royal ward of king Charles I, who allows her love marriage to childhood friend and cousin Harry Fanshawe. But social resistance to the king's absolutism, till then maintained by whip in an iron hand, culminates in a parliamentary rebellion, which spills to utter civil war. It means their utter downfall, Harry being executed because his royalist troops capitulated to military genius Oliver Cromwell's while their estate hosts the royal court on permanent flight.

programme.title: The Devil's Whore
programme.desc: The people of the besieged city of Oxford are in a desperate situation. Devastated by the King's brutal betrayal, Angelica has been cast out of court, and finds herself destitute and starving. Meanwhile, divisions are beginning to split the Parliamentarians.

programme.title: Stranded
programme.desc: David Robinson is being shipped off to a penal colony. His wife and kids are allowed to accompany him. A storm strikes the ship and the family (save for one son, Jacob) are trapped below deck. Jacob is raised by pirates, and the family gets out of the boat and on to land, salvaging as much as they can from the boat, including dogs, chickens, and muskets. They learn to survive and build a shelter on land. Then, Jacob's pirates kidnap Emily, the daughter of a sea-captain. She escapes onto the island and becomes a love interest with Fritz and Ernst. Jacob is reunited with his family during a battle with the pirates over Emily, and she is returned to her father. In the end, the family goes their own ways, some staying on the island, some going home.

programme.title: Snow Queen
programme.desc: After the tragic death of her mother, Gerta and her father continue to run the small inn they call home. For the lonely Gerta, her only joy is her friendship with a handsome young man, Kai. Then one night, an unknown guest arrives at the inn, dressed in furs and diamonds. The next day, she disappears along with Kai.

programme.title: Selling Innocence
programme.desc: Mia Sampson (Sarah Lind), an unpopular girl, is approached at the mall one day to become a model. Even though she thinks modeling is shallow, she thinks it will be a better way to earn money than working for a sushi restaurant and goes to the agency. She poses for photographs which are to be displayed on an Internet website for "members only," supposedly so she can be scouted for other modeling jobs. As Mia's membership begins to go up, she begins feeling uncomfortable and also receives disturbing messages from a subscriber known as Gabriel. However, she continues to take shots and even participates in live video chats with the gentlemen of the site. Too late, Mia realizes that she is working for a pornography site and goes to a group called webwatch to uncover the operation. However, since the agency isn't doing anything illegal, the police can't do anything.

programme.title: Murder Without Conviction
programme.desc: One day after school, Morgan is talking to one of her friends, and the subject of horseback riding comes up. Morgan has never done it before and thinks it's easy, so she decides to take some lessons. Simply put, she's horrible. Morgan quits, but the jersey won't let her do that. It transforms her into a gymnist. Domnique Dawes reminds her of how she never gives up after only one try at something. Morgan returns as a new person, and finds a little success the second time around. Meanwhile, Coleman, Nick, and Elliot all need a new pair of shoes, but have absolutely no money. Nick's father, Larry, offers them a job at his office, ""Lighter than Air"". While there, Coleman finds some really cool clothes, Elliot finds office supplies, and Nick builds an enorous sandwich. Obviously, they didn't do their job. However, they meet Jim Harbaugh, star quarterback for the San Diego Chargers (at the time) and Larry lets the three each get a pair of new shoes for no apparent reason.

programme.title: Love is a Four Letter Word
programme.desc: Margaret and Martin Harper, both sixty years old, are filing for divorce, but plan to keep everything as civilized as possible. Complications arise when their respective attorneys, the equally cynical Emily Bennett and Kenton Rhodes, unexpectedly fall in love, throwing an extra kink into the proceedings both in and out of the courtroom.

Persuaded by a friend to attend her 20th high school reunion, Syd halfheartedly returns to her small hometown where, after years of estrangement, she finally confronts her mother about the past and faces the love she left behind.

programme.title: The Day of the Triffids
programme.desc: Sci-fi mini-series based on the classic novel by John Wyndham. Dougray Scott stars as Bill Masen, an expert on a species of plant that killed his mother in the 1970s. The species, known as triffids, can be used as an alternative fuel and help end global warming. Unfortunately, triffids are extremely dangerous. They are mobile, carnivorous, intelligent, and wreak havoc wherever they go. Starring Joely Richardson, Brian Cox, Vanessa Redgrave and Eddie Izzard.

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: A young Venetian, Marco is abandoned by his father for the merchant Silk Road in the hands of the Mongolian emperor, Kublai Khan, who is at war with China. Kublai recognizes Marco's observation skills, and teaches him the Mongolian culture.

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: Historical drama series based on the escapades of Marco Polo: an infamous merchant-turned-explorer who travelled through Asia in the 13th century. Finding himself in the upper echelons of the Mongol Empire, the Venice-born Marco Polo embarks on a series of adventures in a world filled with war, revenge, tough decisions, love, loyalty, and betrayal. Starring Lorenzo Richelmy as Marco Polo.

programme.title: Jules Verne's Mysterious Island
programme.desc: The free adaptation of Jules Verne's adventure novel takes us to a mysterious island in the Pacific, which seems to be an ideal refuge for deserters on the run. Union captain Cyrus Smith (Kyle MacLachlan), African-American slave Neb (Omar Gooding), widowed sister Jane (Gabrielle Anwar) and her teenage daughter Helen (Danielle Calvert) and two desperate Confederate soldiers already had their teeth full of civil war in their homeland and issued on an adventurous balloon flight into the unknown. They feel they have just found the Promised Land. However, their dream of freedom did not last long. At first glance, the island is inhabited by monsters that give them nothing, and it seems that their only refuge and rescue may be Captain Nemo (Patrick Stewart) and his submarine. The sooner they understand this, the higher their chances of survival ...

programme.title: Dinotopia: The Series
programme.desc: Frank Scott, a wealthy American, crashes his plane into the Caribbean. His two teenaged sons, Karl and David, survive, only to find themselves castaways on Dinotopia. Karl and David are constantly at odds, even as they struggle to adjust to life in their strange new world where talking dinosaurs live side by side in an uneasy alliance with humans. Based upon the book series and the TV miniseries.

programme.title: Dinotopia: The Series
programme.desc: The purpose of the film is to go beyond the notion of the body as a system of functions, symptoms and reflexes that try to delimit the whole body. The body, represented here with all its norms, confronted with itself in a space devoid of causal references, moves towards the abolition of its image and the springing of its inner source: it is the luminous nucleus of the human body.

programme.title: Niagara Motel
programme.desc: A group of struggling individuals cross paths at a low-rent motel in Niagara Falls: a knockout waitress being recruited to star in low budget porn videos, a young couple with a criminal past struggling to recover their child from social services, a middle class husband and wife in a marriage that is disintegrating, a woeful drunken motel manager, a prostitute working to support two small children...

programme.title: The Walking Dead: Dead City
programme.desc: Old enemies, Maggie and Negan, travel to a crumbling, post-apocalyptic Manhattan to fulfill a dangerous mission; filled with the dead and living dwellers, New York City has been transformed into a world full of chaos, danger, terror and beauty.

programme.title: Pandemic
programme.desc: In the near future, a virus of epic proportions has overtaken the planet. There are more Infected than Uninfected, and humanity is losing its grip on survival. Its only hope is finding a cure. After the fall of New York, Lauren - a doctor - has come to Los Angeles to lead the charge in the hunt for Uninfected survivors, and rescue her family barricaded in their LA home. Lauren's objective is simple: lead her team into the field and rescue survivors, filming their experiences so it can be used for research. But nothing could have prepared them for the mayhem they walk into. As they search for Uninfected, fend off the Infected with whatever weapons they can find, and fight for their lives, we see everything from their point of view - directly from their helmet cameras.

As they search for Uninfected, fend off the Infected with whatever weapons they can find, and fight for their lives, we see everything from their point of view - directly from their helmet cameras.

programme.title: Selling Innocence
programme.desc: Mia Sampson (Sarah Lind), an unpopular girl, is approached at the mall one day to become a model. Even though she thinks modeling is shallow, she thinks it will be a better way to earn money than working for a sushi restaurant and goes to the agency. She poses for photographs which are to be displayed on an Internet website for "members only," supposedly so she can be scouted for other modeling jobs. As Mia's membership begins to go up, she begins feeling uncomfortable and also receives disturbing messages from a subscriber known as Gabriel. However, she continues to take shots and even participates in live video chats with the gentlemen of the site. Too late, Mia realizes that she is working for a pornography site and goes to a group called webwatch to uncover the operation. However, since the agency isn't doing anything illegal, the police can't do anything.

programme.title: What I Did for Love
programme.desc: Call him a city slicker. Call him a tenderfoot. But don't call him a member of the family yet. Rising L.A. lawyer James White is going home for the holidays with his fiancée, Sadie Ryder, to finally meet her family in rural Pine Gap. After blundering through a bad first impression, James attempts to win over Sadie's lawyer-loathing father Karl by pretending to be a horse-riding, hay-baling, game-hunting, seasoned square dancer. But a pair of worn jeans and a ten-gallon hat don't make a cowboy, and it's going to take more than mere posturing to charm Mr. Ryder...in fact, it just may take a miracle.

programme.desc: Social. American social drama, produced in 2004. An accident sends Eddie in Heaven! While there, he meets five people who explain to him what the key moments in his life were, through which the real meaning of his life is recorded.

His world needs him; the evil ruler of Earthsea, King Tygath, wants to govern the land with an iron fist, but Ged must learn to harness his powers before he can save his people. Two-part fantasy adventure series.

programme.desc: Téo Hernandez's series of Memories... transcribes perfectly the filmmaker's vertiginous ability to capture a city from a few well-chosen places; the juxtaposition of architecture and people creates a mosaic of sensations, exalted by the syncopation of the zooms and cascading shots, clues to the "manner", the "filmmaker's paw".

programme.title: Dinotopia: The Series
programme.desc: Most of us at some time in our lives feel that we have been wronged by others in some way. It may be as a result of malicious gossip or maybe a violent act or even worse. How do we react in such situations? Do we lash out at the offender, are we eaten up with the desire for revenge? 'A Step Too Far?' investigates an alternative to revenge; the idea of forgiveness. From Northern Ireland to Lancaster County, Pennsylvania, ordinary people share their real life stories and how they have come to view forgiveness. Leading academics also make a significant contribution to the film.

programme.title: To The Ends of The Earth
programme.desc: 1800:- Young Edmund Talbot is sailing to Australia to take up a government post, on a decrepit old ship skippered by Captain Anderson, who is hostile to Edmund until he realizes that he has important relatives. Far more admirable to Edmund are Lieutenants Summer, who has worked his way up through the ranks, and the dashing Deverel. His fellow passengers number demure governess Miss Granham, the republican Mr Prettiman and artist Mr Brocklebank, travelling with his wife and daughter Zenobia - who initiates Edmund into sex - though ultimately he realizes that they are not related, merely a carnal ménage a trois. Also on board is the gauche young vicar Colley, who inadvertently breaches protocol by going onto the bridge uninvited. Ashamed he gets drunk and has gay sex with crew members before locking himself in his cabin, where, despite Edmund's efforts to bring about reconciliation, he wastes away and dies.

programme.title: Mary Bryant
programme.desc: Cornwall, 1786, hungry Mary Broad is sentenced to death for stealing a lady's picnic but 'mercifully' allowed to join for life first governor Phillip's founding shipload to start a penal colony at Botany Bay in New South Wales. On board, she fails to be recruited as 'comfort maid' by gentleman marine infantry Lieutenant Ralph Clarke, but gets the job to save her after near drowning, then loses it again by arrogance and becomes pregnant by male convict William 'Will' Bryant. Pioneer life is a relative relief, especially for able fisherman Will's privileged crew. Harvests are disastrous and Mary becomes Ralph's lover, but only to steal his key for Will's elaborate escape party preparations.

programme.title: Mary Bryant
programme.desc: The escapees' party has got away in one boat, ill-prepared, and after bitter bickering decides to risk sailing to the Dutch Indies. Despite lack of wind, they finally reach Timor. There they pretend to be shipwrecked rich Englishmen and live in luxury on credit for years. When lieutenant Clark passes the island on his way home, he discovers the escaped criminals. William is killed resisting arrest, the rest caught and put on trial in London. The public and press sympathize with the adventurers.

programme.title: The Walking Dead: Dead City
programme.desc: Old enemies, Maggie and Negan, travel to a crumbling, post-apocalyptic Manhattan to fulfill a dangerous mission; filled with the dead and living dwellers, New York City has been transformed into a world full of chaos, danger, terror and beauty.

programme.title: Everything She Ever Wanted
programme.desc: Drama with Gina Gershon. A hedonistic woman weds a college dropout much younger than her to access the Atlantan high society as his father is a high-profile lawyer.

programme.title: The Pleasure of Your Company
programme.desc: Romantic comedy with Karen Valentine. Empty-nesters Jack and Audrey Landry are in for a surprise when their three daughters return home announcing their marriages at the same time.

programme.title: Love is a Four Letter Word
programme.desc: Margaret and Martin Harper, both sixty years old, are filing for divorce, but plan to keep everything as civilized as possible. Complications arise when their respective attorneys, the equally cynical Emily Bennett and Kenton Rhodes, unexpectedly fall in love, throwing an extra kink into the proceedings both in and out of the courtroom.

programme.title: A Place Called Home
programme.desc: Tula Jetters (Ann Margret) is a stubborn widow who still mourns the death of her husband from years ago called "The Captain." She lives alone in a big beautiful home by a lake, but her independence may be threatened by the reality of her diminished vision. She has resisted change, including seeing an eye specialist. Her late husband's niece Billie (Hunter Tylo) and nephew Dave (Sean O'Bryan) have a real estate agency and are now pressuring her to go into assisted living. They have dreams of using her land to make a killing in a big land development. They get a county social worker Jan (Rebecca McFarland) involved in evaluating her independence. Into this mix drops a drifter Henry (Matthew Settle) and his young daughter Cali (Shailene Woodley). Restless Henry becomes a handyman while Cali dreams of having a home here.

programme.title: Wild Hearts
programme.desc: TVmovie about a widowed police officer and his rebellious teenage daughter who move from Los Angeles to the wilds of Montana. Awed by the beauty of the countryside but dismayed by the lack of urban amenities, the pair struggle to adapt to their new ranching lifestyle.

programme.title: Snow Queen
programme.desc: After the tragic death of her mother, Gerta and her father continue to run the small inn they call home. For the lonely Gerta, her only joy is her friendship with a handsome young man, Kai. Then one night, an unknown guest arrives at the inn, dressed in furs and diamonds. The next day, she disappears along with Kai.

programme.title: Snow Queen
programme.desc: After the tragic death of her mother, Gerta and her father continue to run the small inn they call home. programme.title: The Devil's Whore
programme.desc: After Angelica Fanshawe's country noble mother chooses the Catholic faith over the Anglican law of England, her daughter becomes a royal ward of king Charles I, who allows her love marriage to childhood friend and cousin Harry Fanshawe. But social resistance to the king's absolutism, till then maintained by whip in an iron hand, culminates in a parliamentary rebellion, which spills to utter civil war. It means their utter downfall, Harry being executed because his royalist troops capitulated to military genius Oliver Cromwell's while their estate hosts the royal court on permanent flight.

programme.title: The Devil's Whore
programme.desc: The people of the besieged city of Oxford are in a desperate situation. Devastated by the King's brutal betrayal, Angelica has been cast out of court, and finds herself destitute and starving. Meanwhile, divisions are beginning to split the Parliamentarians.

programme.title: Dinotopia: The Series
programme.desc: Frank Scott, a wealthy American, crashes his plane into the Caribbean. His two teenaged sons, Karl and David, survive, only to find themselves castaways on Dinotopia. Karl and David are constantly at odds, even as they struggle to adjust to life in their strange new world where talking dinosaurs live side by side in an uneasy alliance with humans. Based upon the book series and the TV miniseries.

programme.title: Dinotopia: The Series
programme.desc: Filming in her grandparents' home near Padova in Italy, the director identifies a map of places belonging to their past. Antonio was born in Libya when it was an Italian colony, and he lived in Tripoli where he married Narcisa. They were suddenly forced to leave the country in 1970 just after Gaddafi's coup. With the help of a young Libyan contacted on social media, Martina collects images of her grandparents' "hometown" today. As they exchange pictures and chats, their relationship grows, the web allowing them to slowly overcome the physical and cultural boundaries that separate their lives, bringing the audience into a world the media has no access to.

programme.title: To The Ends of The Earth
programme.desc: The ship is becalmed and another vessel is sighted, which turns out to be British - the Alcyone, whose commander announces that the war with France is over. The two vessels anchor alongside and a ball is held for the passengers. Here Edmund meets the sweet Marion Chumley, though he has a rival for affections in Deverel. However, when the two ships part Deverel is exchanged for the Alcyone's officer, the urbane Benet and Edmund confides in Summers his regret at having to say goodbye to Marion. A storm blows up, during which the unfortunate steward Wheeler, considered a Jonah, is thrown overboard and Prettiman severely injured, being nursed rather unexpectedly by Miss Grnham. A mast is also broken and Benet and Summers disagree over the best way to mend it.

programme.title: Human Trafficking
programme.desc: Disenfranchised by economic catastrophe & the fall of a nation, destitute young women & children are left behind and become prey to the underworld. They are a desirable commodity in a billion dollar industry where human beings are bought and sold. In the Ukraine, sixteen-year-old Nadia (Laurence Leboeuf, The Secret) is seduced by the promises of a modeling agency. She runs away from home and disappears. In Southeast Asia, the vacation of a middle-class American couple turns into a nightmare when their twelve-year-old daughter, Annie (Sarah-Jeanne Labrosse, 15/Love), is kidnapped and sold to a brothel. In Prague, Helena (Isabelle Blais, The Barbarian Invasions), a struggling single mother is swept off her feet by the advances of a wealthy businessman. But it's a trap and she too "disappears". In Romania, an orphaned seventeen year old Katerina (Anna Hopkins,Thunderstone) vanishes after meeting her fiancé, whom she met online. The horrific destiny of each victim is tied to a sex-trafficking ring. It's the job of Kate Morozov (Oscar and Golden Globe winner Mira Sorvino, Mighty Aphrodite), a detective for Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) to help find the men responsible. But first she knows she must win the faith of the victims who have learned firsthand the futility of trust. While Annie's parents join forces with Tom Halloran (Terry Haig, The Aviator) and a renegade worker for an NGO, scouting a child-prostitution ring, Nadia's grief-stricken father Viktor is embarking on his own personal hunt to find the men responsible. From a torture chamber in the suburbs of Queens to the flesh-peddlers of Russia the hunt is on, revealing a shocking conspiracy of global proportions. Featuring Emmy and Golden Globe winner Donald Sutherland, (The Italian Job) and Robert Carlyle (The Full Monty) Human Trafficking is at once a gripping government procedural, a cautionary tale of an international scourge, and one of the most compulsively important thrillers of the ye.

programme.title: Human Trafficking
programme.desc: Human Trafficking is an American crime drama series dealing with the terrible crime of selling people into the sex slave industry. The series follows an American agent, Kate Morozov, as she goes undercover to investigate the cases of dead prostitutes suspecting they are victims of trafficking. Meanwhile, three young women from different parts of the world are forced to become sex workers, as part of the international network led by Sergei Karpovich. Helena, a single mother from Prague has a chance to testify.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Kauno „Žalgiris" - Paryžiaus „Paris Basketball"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Untamed Philippines
programme.desc: Moving from turtles of the Palawan coast to the unique National Marine Park at Tubbataha, to meet giants, whale sharks and manta rays. We also see how people can mediate between people and wildlife as we join a snake hunting team catching and translocating a deadly Samar cobra.

programme.title: South America's Weirdest Animals
programme.desc: South America is a rich and diverse land. Stunning landscapes harbor elusive critters that have evolved to thrive here. But survival is not assured because the abundant prey is closely followed by powerful predators. From giant killer dolphins to the largest cat in the Americas, this vast continent is a lethal predator battleground.

programme.title: Animal Fight Club
programme.desc: Nature's vicious battles for survival come at every scale, from 6 ton Elephants, fighting in a testosterone fuelled blind fury, to slime covered inch and half long amphibian kick boxers, dangling in the jaws of death. This is a no-holds barred look at cold-hearted killers in the wild, revealing ambush experts with piercing canines, slithering assassins with crushing coils, and multi-layered fangs dealing death, in Animal Fight Club.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: This show explores the unbridled natural beauty of America's national parks and highlights some of the most awe-inspiring scenery on the planet. Travelling beyond the more conventional tourist hot-spots, the viewer is transported to the hidden wonders of America's wild spaces. Episodes include joining a scientific exploration of the 277 mile long Grand Canyon, studying its geological history, exploring the microscopic colonies of vegetation and examining its unique creatures; journeying through the Everglades, a 1.5 million acre home to strange creatures, carnivorous plants, amphibious birds and fish that can breathe air; and navigating across the northwest archipelago of Hawaii following a team of diving scientists as they inspect the unique aquaeous flora and fauna.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: The sparse African Savannah can be a fearsome place for both herds of powerful prey and the lurking predators who hunt them down. In this captivating documentary series from National Geographic, the relationship between predator and prey is closely examined, exploring the fight for survival for both sets of animals. These herds are full of powerful or agile animals, making the job of a predator to feed itself and its family a troublesome task. But the African predators are ruthless and proficient hunters, and if a herd is infiltrated, or a straggling member is targeted, they will struggle to evade these savage carnivores.

programme.title: Death at the River
programme.desc: Embark on a riveting journey along the untamed waters of Africa, where the rivers teem with life, and witness the breathtaking struggle for survival against extreme droughts, cunning predators, and opportunistic hunters of all sizes. Africa's rivers, a paradise for predators, become the arena where prey and predator engage in a relentless dance for life. From the crocodile-infested Mara to the arid landscapes of the Luangwa Valley, each river presents a unique set of perils that only the most resilient can endure. Every moment becomes a high-stakes game where only the most cunning and adaptable will emerge victorious.

programme.title: When Sharks Attack... And Why
programme.desc: From America's coastlines to exotic beaches around the world, shark attacks are becoming more unpredictable. Many of these attacks occur suddenly, in large numbers and in unexpected locations — puzzling locals and scientists alike. Experts investigate these mysterious incidents to discover what is affecting some of nature's most feared fish.

programme.title: Mara: Rebirth
programme.desc: Part 1 of our series starts with the dust of the disappearing migration as it heads off across the river and leaves. Behind them, hundreds if not thousands of other animals cannot move, or won't move, because they are locked into territories, invisible barriers that say to them, 'leave your bubble at your peril'. This is their story. It is the story about what happens between September and the following July. Nine months of wildebeest-free Mara.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Panda School
programme.desc: The junior cubs at Panda School are learning essential life skills, and first on the curriculum is chewing bamboo. It's tougher than it looks. Even holding it right is a challenge for most of the cubs. Shy Qing Yang catches on quickest, leaving her twin brother, Can Yang, at the bottom of this class. But he's got other strengths and is soon outsmarting the others with his climbing abilities. Affectionately nicknamed "Dirtbag" is the quietest panda in school, but she's an A student when it comes to balance. She's introverted but self-sufficient, a characteristic that could shape her future. In a special semi-wild enclosure further up the mountain, Tian Tian is raising her cub with the ultimate goal of releasing him into the wild. And there is excitement in the maternity unit as they prepare for the arrival of the next generation.

programme.title: Wild Costa Rica
programme.desc: Life and death are close companions in an Eden called Costa Rica. Nestled in the tropics of Central America, Costa Rica calls itself the land of "Pura Vida" - pure life. In a phenomenon known as the "Arribada", the arrival, olive ridley sea turtles migrate annually in massive numbers while troops of capuchin, squirrel, howler monkeys and resplendent quetzals forage in the canopy above. Below roam deadly army ants, poison dart frogs and the strongest insect on earth, the Hercules beetle.

programme.title: Built for the Kill

Built for the Kill: Killer Whale exposes real life and death struggles in dramatic second-by-second detail.

programme.title: Built for the Kill
programme.desc: The killer whale is the world's biggest dolphin-32 feet long and up to six tons heavy. Smart, sophisticated, and social, they live in groups and hunt cooperatively. Built for the Kill: Killer Whale exposes real life and death struggles in dramatic second-by-second detail.

programme.title: Cat Attack-Tics
programme.desc: Explore the many ways wild cats go in for the kill. Cats rarely seen in action, such as the marbled cat, the fishing cat and the sand cat, will all be featured in Cat Attack-tics. Classic Nat Geo footage is mixed with high-tech graphics, freeze frames and photo finishes to magnify the killer weaponry.

programme.title: Lions: The Hunt For Survival
programme.desc: Lions - the most feared, most iconic predator in Africa but a lion is not just a lion. Each is very different to the other. Different parts of Africa demand specific things from lions to survive. The secret is to be highly adaptable. At the end of the day, the livelihood of the pride rests on the female's shoulders. She's the one who must excel. Follow three lionesses from different parts of the continent to see how they respond to win?

programme.title: Cat Wars: Lion vs Cheetah
programme.desc: Caught on tape in Africa's wild Serengeti is a stunning act of violence between two top predators. Three cheetahs are brutally attacked by two male lions - the first time an attack like this has ever been filmed. Now, filmmaker Leo Kuenkel, who witnessed the attack, is trying to make sense of it. Was this a once-in-a-lifetime "perfect storm" event? Or do these iconic African cats have a deep-set, sinister reason to fight to the death?

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: On this special episode, the team at Pol Veterinary Services cares for baby animals while the Pols welcome an adorable new puppy. A calf suffers from severe pneumonia, a tiny kitten has an enormous grub, and an abandoned puppy is rescued from the side of the road. An emergency call takes Dr. Pol to a farm where a cow's labor has stalled. The vets have their hands full checking on litters of puppies. Dr. Pol helps Hope, a lovable foal struggling to walk, get back on her hooves. Amid all of this, the Pols find time to enjoy bonding with the new addition to their family, Lily, a fluffy puppy who already brings them so much joy both at the clinic and at home.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Tourists capture the best moments in the wild with their phones, and the big cats are at the top of everyone's safari wish list. Hold on as an elephant charges with a lion in its tusks. Watch male leopards in a turf war, and beware of one mother leopard's hunting school. Cheetahs confront crocodiles to protect their meal. Large buffalo herds gather as a lone lion shows why he is king.

programme.title: Mashatu: Land of Leopards
programme.desc: In Botswana's Mashatu Game Reserve, one of the last sanctuaries for free-roaming leopards, a mother gives birth to two cubs. She'll stop at nothing to protect them. But as climate change tightens its grip, resources dwindle, and a fierce leopard war looms. Over three years of intimate observation, this film unveils rare, breathtaking footage of behaviors never before documented, offering an unprecedented glimpse into the resilience and secrets of this elusive species.

programme.title: Night Stalkers
programme.desc: Unique night vision and thermal cameras penetrate the darkness to reveal Africa's notorious hyenas hunting in their element. Thousands of wildebeest and zebra migrate through Kenya's Masai Mara National Reserve every year and the hyenas team up to hunt them cooperatively. Specially developed cameras reveal a rare, intelligent and playful side to the fascinating animals.

programme.title: World's Deadliest Killer Three
programme.desc: This series looks at the natural born killers of the animal kingdom with each episode focusing on a particular, shared aspect of what makes these creatures successful predators. In 'Little Killers', we see how a lack of physical size can be overcome when hunting prey and miniscule attackers are able to bring down prey that are massive in comparison. In 'Speed Kills', the spotlight is shone on those predators who use their incredibly fast skills to catch their food. From the fastest animal on land, the cheetah, to the stargazer fish that dispatches its prey in a tenth of a second to the deadly black mamba, some of these attacks are so fast that they cannot be captured using slow-motion. In 'Hunger Games', the emphasis is placed on the driving force behind the majority of attacks, the desire for food.

SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: The Fairly OddParents tells us a story of Timmy Turner, a 10-year-old boy in the fictional town of Dimmsdale. Vicky is his babysitter with vicious temper. His parents are completely indifferent to him. His life is very sad and hopeless until his fairy godparents Wanda and Cosmo apperar in the fishbowl and try to fulfill his every wish. Timmy's greenness in making his wishes causes troubles and he has to "unwish" them together with his fairy godparents to avoid possible disasters. Enjoy Timmy's fantastic adventures in the world of fairies, dragons, unicorns and dwarfs.

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: A prequel to SpongeBob SquarePants, featuring the beloved characters as children, spending their summertime at Camp Coral having fun doing typical camp activities like building campfires, catching jellyfish, and swimming in Lake Yuckymuck, causing a bit of trouble and chaos on the side. SpongeBob SquarePants is a ten-year-old with a red cap, goofy and friendly as he's always been. Let's not forget SpongeBob's friends, Patrick, Sandy, and Squidward, who's a bit older than the others and works as a junior counselor. All other characters such as Mr. Krabs, Mrs. Puff, SpongeBob's nemesis Plankton, and Karen are a part of this adventure as well.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Nuts to You/The Terror of Madagascar Description : Nuts to You: Fred the Squirrel has hit the jackpot. He stumbles onto a jackpot oak tree which is loaded with acorns (that's tons of money to animal folk). He's going to need financial advice, and who better to offer sound advice than King Julien? The two enter a partnership looking for ways to spend on the good life. The Red Squirrel has designs on the loot, though, and captures the hapless twosome in order to squeeze the acorns out of them. Will the evil squirrel's precisely planned plot pay or get him played? The Terror of Madagascar: A special delivery has come from Madagascar. What is it? A baby Fossa! Everyone is enchanted by the little tyke except King Julien, who sees him as a lemur-devouring predator, and he has the toothmarks on his butt to prove it! Julien formulates a plan to get rid of the adorable little carnivore, but his slithery solution becomes much worse than the problem!

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Best Laid Plaintains: It's a special day when Bada and Bing get a shipment of delicious plantains to eat. Although they jealously guard the African bananas, King Julien's determined to taste them too. He sneaks into the gorilla habitat while they sleep, and he and Marlene end up eating a few too many for the gorillas not to notice. Like all of them. When they realize what they've done they head for the hills as fast as their stolen car can take them. Can the penguins calm the savage beasts before they bash the banana bandits? P.E.L.T.: Skipper's losing it. His performance on the obstacle course is actually slowing down, so he has to trigger a special fitness test to prove he can still lead the squad. Kowalski takes over as Skipper excuses himself to go on his fitness quest. The brainy bird appears to do a bang-up job in the leadership role - are Skipper's days at the helm over but he's too chicken to admit it?

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.desc: Marc Forster dirige Tom Hanks in una pellicola dolceamara. Dopo la morte della moglie, Otto è un uomo rigido e solo. Ma la sua vita sarà sconvolta dall’arrivo di una nuova vicina.

programme.title: Educazione fisica
programme.desc: Giovanna Mezzogiorno, Claudio Santamaria e Sergio Rubini in un film sceneggiato dai fratelli D'Innocenzo. Una preside convoca un gruppo di genitori con una notizia choc sui loro figli.

programme.title: Donnie Brasco
programme.desc: Johnny Depp e Al Pacino immensi interpreti di un avvincente gangster-movie. Un agente FBI conquista la fiducia di un anziano mafioso, nascondendo la sua identita' fino all'ultimo.

programme.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Golden Globe a Leonardo DiCaprio nel biopic di Martin Scorsese con Margot Robbie. L'incredibile ascesa di Jordan Belfort, un broker attratto dalla sete di potere e da una vita dissoluta.

programme.title: Questo O Quello - Steven Spielberg - Ep. 272 - Questo O Quello - Steven Spielberg
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si confrontano su alcune delle migliori pellicole del regista premio Oscar che ha fatto e continua a far sognare generazioni di spettatori.

programme.title: Notre-Dame in fiamme
programme.desc: La pellicola Sky Original di Jean-Jacques Annaud sull'incendio che colpi' la cattedrale parigina nel 2019 e su coloro che sfidarono le fiamme per mettere in salvo tesori inestimabili.

programme.title: Michael Collins
programme.desc: Leone d’oro a Venezia 1996 per il regista Neil Jordan e Coppa Volpi a Liam Neeson, leader guerrigliero nell'Irlanda lacerata e insanguinata dalle lotte del movimento indipendentista. Uscito di prigione dove era stato rinchiuso in seguito agli scontri armati di Dublino del 1916, Collins continua la sua lotta contro il dominio britannico, riuscendo a fare proseliti grazie al suo carisma. Intanto insieme a un gruppo di militanti, organizza attacchi e azioni di sabotaggio contro il governo che non esiterà a usare anche mezzi poco leciti per intimidirlo.

programme.title: Edtv
programme.desc: La rete True TV è in crisi. Al fine di aumentare gli ascolti la direttrice decide di seguire 24 ore su 24 la vita di un uomo normale, azione che porta a radicali cambiamenti all'esistenza del protagonista.

programme.title: Edison - L'uomo che illumino' il mondo
programme.desc: Benedict Cumberbatch, Tom Holland e Michael Shannon nel biopic su Thomas Edison. L'avvincente storia del pioniere dell'industria elettrica che ha cambiato la vita degli esseri umani.

programme.title: Will Hunting - Genio ribelle
programme.desc: Oscar a Robin Williams e alla sceneggiatura per il capolavoro di Gus Van Sant con Matt Damon e Ben Affleck. Un genio allo sbando incontra uno psicologo. La sua vita cambierà per sempre.

programme.title: Educazione fisica
programme.desc: Giovanna Mezzogiorno, Claudio Santamaria e Sergio Rubini in un film sceneggiato dai fratelli D'Innocenzo. Una preside convoca un gruppo di genitori con una notizia choc sui loro figli.

programme.title: Le Mans '66 - La grande sfida
programme.desc: Due Oscar per il biopic di James Mangold con Christian Bale e Matt Damon, sulla storica sfida tra Ford e Ferrari. Carroll Shelby ha vinto la prestigiosa 24 Ore di Le Mans nel 1959 ma una patologia cardiaca gli proibisce di continuare a gareggiare. Si reinventa allora designer di automobili e accetta la proposta della Ford: progettare una macchina in grado di battere il bolide della Ferrari. Ma oltre al motore, per vincere serve anche un pilota super. E la scelta di Shelby ricade su Ken Miles, un intrepido e irascibile pilota britannico. Nel cast Remo Girone interpreta Enzo Ferrari.

programme.title: Troy
programme.desc: Brad Pitt, Eric Bana e Orlando Bloom nel kolossal ispirato al poema omerico. Dopo il rapimento di Elena da parte di Paride, Agamennone guida gli spartani contro i troiani.

programme.title: House of the Dragon
programme.desc: Rhaenyra e Aegon rafforzano la loro morsa su un trono ormai fatiscente. Tradimento, profezie e fuoco ridisegnano il destino di Westeros con il sangue.

programme.title: Grease - Brillantina
programme.desc: L'intramontabile musical con John Travolta e Olivia Newton-John. Una high school nell'America degli anni '50 incornicia le vicende amorose fra la romantica Sandy e lo spavaldo Danny Zuko.

programme.title: Jarhead
programme.desc: Swofford, arruolato come suo padre e suo nonno prima di lui, durante l'operazione Desert Storm, nella prima Guerra del Golfo, attraversa i deserti mediorientali con i soldati iracheni sempre potenzialmente all'orizzonte.

programme.title: Lansky
programme.desc: Biopic con Harvey Keitel e Sam Worthington. Sotto custodia dell'FBI, l’anziano mafioso bielorusso Meyer Lansky, esponente del ‘Sindacato ebraico’, racconta la sua vita a un giornalista.

programme.title: September 5 - La diretta che cambiò la storia
programme.desc: Il ritmo serrato del thriller per ripercorrere uno storico evento mediatico. 1972: durante le Olimpiadi di Monaco di Baviera, un commando palestinese uccide due atleti israeliani e ne prende in ostaggio nove. Una troupe della ABC documenta i drammatici eventi in tempo reale.

programme.title: Starman
programme.desc: Il docufilm di Gianluca Cerasola dedicato a Luca Parmitano, il primo astronauta italiano a diventare comandante della ISS e a battere il record di permanenza extraveicolare nello Spazio.

programme.title: A beautiful mind
programme.desc: 4 Oscar e 4 Golden Globe per il capolavoro di Ron Howard con Russell Crowe e Jennifer Connelly. L'avvincente biografia di John Nash, genio matematico e premio Nobel affetto da schizofrenia.

programme.title: Il talento di Mr. Ripley
programme.desc: Matt Damon, Jude Law e Gwyneth Paltrow nel thriller dal romanzo di Patricia Highsmith. Incaricato di riportare a casa il figlio di un magnate, un uomo e' coinvolto in un tragico intrigo.

programme.title: Better Man
programme.desc: Michael Gracey confeziona un originale biopic su Robbie Williams, rappresentato sullo schermo da una scimmia: da timido bambino diventerà una pop star internazionale.

programme.title: Grease - Brillantina
programme.desc: L'intramontabile musical con John Travolta e Olivia Newton-John. Una high school nell'America degli anni '50 incornicia le vicende amorose fra la romantica Sandy e lo spavaldo Danny Zuko.

programme.title: Codice d'onore
programme.desc: Tom Cruise sfida Jack Nicholson in un dramma giudiziario con Demi Moore e Kevin Bacon. Tre avvocati militari difendono due marines accusati dell'omicidio di un commilitone.

programme.title: Rumba Therapy
programme.desc: Commedia di e con Franck Dubosc. Sopravvissuto a un infarto, Tony riprende in mano la sua vita e decide di rintracciare la figlia, ormai adulta, che non ha mai conosciuto.

programme.title: Duel
programme.desc: David Mann, tranquillo commesso, si ritrova imprigionato in un pericoloso gioco al gatto e al topo in autostrada con un mostruoso camion guidato da un misterioso psicopatico.

programme.title: A beautiful mind
programme.desc: 4 Oscar e 4 Golden Globe per il capolavoro di Ron Howard con Russell Crowe e Jennifer Connelly. L'avvincente biografia di John Nash, genio matematico e premio Nobel affetto da schizofrenia.

programme.title: Il piacere è tutto mio
programme.desc: Commedia romantica sulla 'sex positivity' con Emma Thompson e Daryl McCormack. Nancy, vedova matura e insoddisfatta, ingaggia un giovane gigolo' per vivere la sua prima esperienza appagante.

programme.title: I segreti di Wind River
programme.desc: Jeremy Renner ed Elizabeth Olsen in un thriller premiato a Cannes. Un cacciatore collabora con una giovane agente dell'FBI per scoprire il killer di una ragazza nativo-americana.

programme.title: The Untouchables - Gli intoccabili
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Sean Connery, nel capolavoro di Brian De Palma con Kevin Costner e Robert De Niro. Chicago, 1930: una squadra speciale viene incaricata di incastrare Al Capone.

programme.title: The Happy Prince
programme.desc: Esordio alla regia per Rupert Everett nei panni di Oscar Wilde. A Parigi si consumano gli ultimi giorni dello scrittore, rinnegato da chi lo aveva idolatrato. Nel cast Colin Firth.

programme.desc: Avventuroso reboot del film datato 1943, che riporta sullo schermo il cane più famoso del cinema. Finito in una famiglia che non esita a maltrattarlo, Lassie riesce a scappare e affronta molti pericoli pur di ricongiungersi con il suo affezionato padrone Florian.

programme.desc: A caccia di spettri in una commedia fantastica. Tom fa amicizia con il fantasmino Hugo e chiede aiuto a un'investigatrice dell'occulto per aiutarlo a tornare a casa.

programme.title: Trolls World Tour
programme.desc: Secondo capitolo d'animazione con le bambole targate Dreamworks. Poppy e Branch scoprono l'esistenza di sei diverse tribu' di Trolls, ognuna dedicata a un genere musicale: Pop, Funk, Musica classica, Techno, Country e Hard Rock. E proprio la tribu' dei rockettari, guidata da Re Trash (doppiato da Ozzy Osbourne nella versione originale) e dalla Regina Barb, ha elaborato il piu' cattivo dei propositi: regnare su tutti gli altri Trolls, eliminando gli altri generi musicali affinche' il rock regni. Poppy e Branch e tutti i loro amici si impegneranno per far prevalere l'armonia.

programme.title: Ritorno al futuro
programme.desc: Michael J.Fox nel primo capitolo della trilogia cult di Robert Zemeckis. Anni '80: con una macchina del tempo, l'adolescente Marty McFly finisce nel 1955 e incontra i suoi futuri genitori.

programme.title: Rango
programme.desc: Oscar 2012 al miglior film d'animazione. Un bizzarro camaleonte giunge in una cittadina del selvaggio West oppressa dalla siccità e da una spietata banda di fuorilegge senza scrupoli.

programme.title: Scooby!
programme.desc: Il reboot di animazione targato Warner che celebra i 50 anni degli amati personaggi di Hanna-Barbera. La nascita dell’amicizia fra Scooby-Doo e Shaggy si intreccia con un nuovo caso da risolvere per la Mystery Inc., alle prese con il malvagio Dick Dastardly, che vuole liberare il cane infernale Cerbero.

programme.title: Unicorni
programme.desc: Blu è un bambino che sogna di interpretare la Sirenetta. Suo padre Lucio non sa come affrontare le richieste del figlio mentre sua moglie, Elena, tende ad assecondare le richieste di Blu. Il gruppo di "Genitori Unicorni" sostiene la famiglia.

Gli viene data la possibilità di ritrovarlo, anche per salvare la vita dell'amico Proteo ma il focoso marinaio non ne ha tanta voglia: meglio andare alle Isole Fiji, in cerca di sole e divertimento_ Ma a vigilare sulla missione c'è la coraggiosa Marina... Fra discoteche e fogne, la caccia al mutante è aperta, ma Blade scoprirà una verità sconcertante.

Per uscire dal blocco creativo, uno scrittore si rivolge a un’eccentrica medium, che rievoca lo spirito dell’ex moglie. Questa presenza susciterà le gelosie dell’attuale consorte.

programme.title: Nove lune e mezza
programme.desc: Michela Andreozzi dirige e interpreta una commedia con Claudia Gerini e Giorgio Pasotti. Livia accetta di fungere da madre surrogata per co della sorella, all'insaputa dei rispettivi fidanzati.

programme.desc: Commedia con Robert De Niro, Katherine Heigl, Susan Sarandon e Diane Keaton. In occasione delle nozze del figlio adottivo, due coniugi, separati da anni, fingono di andare d'accordo.

programme.desc: Una commedia sentimentale di Luca Lucini con Nicolas Maupas. Un brillante studente di filosofia viene ingiustamente accusato di un reato che non ha commesso e condannato ai servizi sociali, dove incontra Flor, un'attivista che gli cambiera' la vita.

programme.title: Aline - La voce dell'amore

programme.title: Moglie e marito
programme.desc: Fioccano gli equivoci nella commedia con Pierfrancesco Favino e Kasia Smutniak. Andrea e' un affermato neurochirurgo, sua moglie Sofia una conduttrice televisiva: sono sposati, hanno due figli ma il loro rapporto attraversa una crisi nera. Non riescono proprio a capire le reciproche difficolta', almeno fino a quando non ci mette lo zampino il destino: un esperimento scientifico riuscito male scaraventa l'uno nel corpo dell'altra innescando una serie di momenti imbarazzanti ma molto divertenti. Andrea e Sofia scopriranno nella pratica cosa significa vivere nei panni del partner.

programme.title: La casa sul lago del tempo
programme.desc: Sandra Bullock e Keanu Reeves in una love story che trascende lo spazio e il tempo. Arrivato nella sua nuova casa sul lago, Alex trova una lettera della precedente inquilina, Kate, con cui inizia un rapporto epistolare. I due continuano a scriversi e finiscono per innamorarsi, ma scoprono di non potersi incontrare perche' vivono in anni diversi: lui nel 2004, lei nel 2006. Ispirato a "Il mare", film coreano inedito in Italia diretto da Hyun-Seung Lee, con Sandra Bullock e Keanu Reeves che tornano a lavorare insieme 12 anni dopo "Speed".

programme.title: Penguin Bloom
programme.desc: Naomi Watts e Andrew Lincoln in un'emozionante storia vera. Paralizzata a causa di un incidente, una donna trova il coraggio di ricominciare prendendosi cura di una gazza ferita.

programme.title: Alla vita
programme.desc: Riccardo Scamarcio e Lou de Laage nell'opera prima di Stephane Freiss. Una giovane, di famiglia ebrea ortodossa, incontra un uomo con cui esplora il desiderio di ribellarsi alla tradizione.

programme.title: Il Capitale Umano - Human Capital
programme.desc: Marisa Tomei, Liev Schreiber e Peter Sarsgaard nell’adattamento del romanzo di Stephen Amidon. La relazione fra i rispettivi figli adolescenti spinge la vita di due famiglie in una spirale di rapporti ambigui e torbidi affari. Una svolta inaspettata stravolgerà gli equilibri.

programme.title: Fire Squad - Incubo di fuoco
programme.desc: Spettacolare film drammatico con Jeff Bridges, Josh Brolin e Jennifer Connelly ispirato alle vicende di un gruppo di pompieri addestrati nel combattere gli incendi di montagna. Un pauroso incendio in Arizona sara' la loro tragica prova del fuoco.

programme.title: Gioia mia
programme.desc: Gioia, un'insegnante di letteratura francese, instaura un legame proibito, fragile e inspiegabilmente necessario con Alessio, un suo studente. Quest'ultimo però distrugge tutto e cancella l'unica persona che lo abbia mai amato.

programme.title: L'ultimo giorno sulla Terra
programme.desc: Sci-fi movie con Jean Reno e Hugo Becker, opera prima di Romain Quirot. 2050: un planetoide ha desertificato il globo e ora sta per distruggerlo. Paul e' l'unico astronauta che puo' fermarlo.

programme.title: Uno di noi
programme.desc: Kevin Costner e Diane Lane in un dramma dai risvolti thrilling. Uno sceriffo e la moglie lasciano il ranch nel Montana per salvare la nuora e il nipote da una famiglia di criminali.

programme.title: La promessa - Il prezzo del potere
programme.desc: Isabelle Huppert in un pellicola che entra nel cuore della politica. Prima di concludere il suo mandato, una sindaca vuole realizzare il piano di riqualificazione di una banlieu.

programme.title: Collateral Beauty
programme.desc: Will Smith è la star di un commovente dramma sul dolore e la perdita. Segnato dalla morte della figlia, Howard, un pubblicitario di New York, si chiude in se stesso perdendo ogni interesse per cio' che lo circonda. L'unica sua reazione concreta consiste nella scrittura di lettere indirizzate alla Morte, al Tempo e all'Amore. Ai suoi amici non resta che assecondarlo mentre escogitano un piano per aiutarlo a riprendere in mano la propria vita. Dal regista de "Il diavolo veste Prada". Cast da tappeto rosso: Edward Norton, Keira Knightley, Naomie Harris e i premi Oscar Helen Mirren e Kate Winslet.

programme.desc: Toccante pellicola di Edoardo Gabbriellini. Dopo un lungo processo e la prigione, Veronica viene scagionata dall'accusa di omicidio. Tornata in liberta', fatica ad avere una vita normale.

programme.desc: Miglior sceneggiatura a Berlino 2019 per il film di Claudio Giovannesi tratto dal bestseller di Roberto Saviano. Napoli: l'ascesa di un gruppo di giovanissimi nel mondo della criminalita'.

Ma sarà lui a salvare il ragazzo dal branco, divenendo il suo mentore. David di Donatello e Nastro d’argento come miglior film straniero.

programme.desc: Una squadra di comici, capitanati da Christian De Sica ed Enrico Brignano, per una commedia sull'Italia di oggi. I Tucci sono una numerosa famiglia di un paesino laziale. Da sempre poveri, vincono 100 milioni alla lotteria e la loro vita si trasforma. Per non far sapere di essere i fortunati possessori del biglietto, si trasferiscono in un lussuoso hotel milanese dando vita a un'escalation di risate e a una serie di situazioni paradossali. Diretto da Fausto Brizzi, il film e' un remake di "Les Tuche", grande successo in Francia. Gustoso cameo di Al Bano. Nel cast la grande Anna Mazzamauro.

Max Simkin e' un solitario calzolaio newyorkese che conduce una vita grigia e monotona. Almeno fino a quando, nella sua bottega, non scopre una vecchia risuolatrice: un vero e proprio cimelio, che gli permette di trasformarsi in ognuno dei suoi clienti semplicemente indossando le loro scarpe. Max ne approfittera' per dare un lustro piu' elettrizzante e avventuroso alla sua esistenza, assumendo varie identita' e andando incontro a momenti divertenti e imprevisti imbarazzanti.

programme.title: Un figlio di nome Erasmus
programme.desc: Le ‘Iene’ Luca e Paolo in una commedia con Ricky Memphis e Daniele Liotti. Quattro amici quarantenni tornano a Lisbona per il funerale di Amalia, con cui tutti ebbero una storia ai tempi dell’università, e scoprono che la donna ha messo al mondo un figlio. Chi di loro è il padre?

programme.title: Il mammone
programme.desc: Diego Abatantuono, Angela Finocchiaro e Andrea Pisani nel remake della commedia francese "Tanguy". Due genitori esasperati si alleano per cacciare di casa il viziato figlio ultratrentenne.

programme.title: Mai Stati Uniti
programme.desc: Commedia di Carlo Vanzina con Vincenzo Salemme e Ambra Angiolini. Cinque persone scoprono di essere figlie dello stesso padre. Per ricevere l'eredita', devono spargerne le ceneri in Arizona.

programme.title: Riunione di famiglia (Non sposate le mie figlie 3)
programme.desc: Terzo capitolo della saga multietnica con Christian Clavier. Per il 40esimo anniversario di matrimonio di Claude e Marie le figlie organizzano una festa a sorpresa.

programme.title: L'aereo più pazzo del mondo
programme.desc: Cult del cinema demenziale con Leslie Nielsen. Un tassista si imbarca sul volo dove l'ex fidanzata lavora come hostess per riconquistarla. Quando i motori vanno in avaria, inizia il delirio.

programme.title: Il Principe di Roma
programme.desc: Edoardo Falcone dirige una commedia con Marco Giallini, Giulia Bevilacqua, Sergio Rubini. Un avido uomo d'affari, bramoso di un titolo nobiliare, riceve la visita di illustri fantasmi.

programme.title: Miami supercops: I poliziotti dell'8a strada
programme.desc: Doug e Steve sono grandi amici: il primo lavora per l'FBI, il secondo ha lasciato l'agenzia perché nauseato dalla burocrazia che, secondo lui, lega le mani alla giustizia. La riapertura di un caso, però, richiede l'esperienza e l'astuzia di entrambi.

programme.title: La Primavera Della Mia Vita
programme.desc: Esordio cinematografico del duo Colapesce Dimartino in un road movie con Stefania Rocca e Corrado Fortuna. Tre anni dopo lo scioglimento, due musicisti si ritrovano in un bizzarro progetto.

programme.title: Sconnessi
programme.desc: Commedia corale con Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Ricky Memphis, Carolina Crescentini e Stefano Fresi. I componenti di una famiglia entrano in crisi quando si ritrovano in una baita senza internet.

programme.title: Mollami
programme.desc: Road movie targato Sky Original diretto da Matteo Gentiloni. Un’adolescente problematica viene costretta dal padre ad andare in collegio, ma il viaggio non sarà semplice.

programme.title: Belli ciao
programme.desc: Il duo comico di successo Pio e Amedeo nella commedia diretta da Gennaro Nunziante. Due amici d'infanzia, separati da scelte diverse, si ritrovano dopo anni fra differenze e sogni in comune.

programme.title: Il mammone
programme.desc: Diego Abatantuono, Angela Finocchiaro e Andrea Pisani nel remake della commedia francese "Tanguy". Due genitori esasperati si alleano per cacciare di casa il viziato figlio ultratrentenne.

programme.title: Poveri ma ricchi
programme.desc: Una squadra di comici, capitanati da Christian De Sica ed Enrico Brignano, per una commedia sull'Italia di oggi. I Tucci sono una numerosa famiglia di un paesino laziale. Da sempre poveri, vincono 100 milioni alla lotteria e la loro vita si trasforma. Per non far sapere di essere i fortunati possessori del biglietto, si trasferiscono in un lussuoso hotel milanese dando vita a un'escalation di risate e a una serie di situazioni paradossali. Diretto da Fausto Brizzi, il film e' un remake di "Les Tuche", grande successo in Francia. Gustoso cameo di Al Bano. Nel cast la grande Anna Mazzamauro.

programme.title: Riunione di famiglia (Non sposate le mie figlie 3)
programme.desc: Terzo capitolo della saga multietnica con Christian Clavier. Per il 40esimo anniversario di matrimonio di Claude e Marie le figlie organizzano una festa a sorpresa.

programme.title: Il club dei divorziati
programme.desc: Esilarante commedia francese con Arnaud Ducret. Deluso dal tradimento dell'ex moglie di cui e' ancora innamorato, Ben si unisce all'estroverso amico Patrick per godersi i piaceri della vita.

programme.title: Poveri Noi
programme.desc: La ricca famiglia Mariani affronta la rovina finanziaria ed è costretta a trasferirsi in una zona popolare, dove le persone che hanno sempre disprezzato in passato si rivelano le uniche disposte ad aiutarli.

programme.title: Il Principe di Roma

programme.title: Cado dalle nubi
programme.desc: L'esordio al cinema di Checco Zalone in una commedia ricca di gag. Un aspirante cantante pugliese si trasferisce a Milano in cerca di successo e si innamora della figlia di un leghista.

programme.title: Il Paradiso all'improvviso
programme.desc: Uno scapolo incallito vive da solo, ha un grande ego e molti amici, ma le cose cambiano quando incontra una ragazza piena di mistero.

programme.title: Pari e dispari
programme.desc: Il guardiamarina Johnny Firpo viene incaricato dai suoi superiori di indagare su una banda di allibratori clandestini operanti in Florida. Dato che egli ignora quasi tutto del gioco, verrà affiancato da qualcuno che, invece, ne sappia.

programme.title: Monty Python - Il senso della vita
programme.desc: Gran Premio della Giuria a Cannes per l'ultimo capolavoro degli inimitabili Monty Python. La loro comicità visionaria esplode in una serie di sketch surreali e irriverenti.

programme.title: The Estate
programme.desc: Commedia Sky Original con Kathleen Turner, Anna Faris, Toni Collette e David Duchovny. Due sorelle accorrono dalla ricca zia malata con la speranza di conquistarne la stima e... l'eredita'.

programme.title: La prima pietra
programme.desc: Corrado Guzzanti, Lucia Mascino e Kasia Smutniak in una graffiante commedia sull'Italia di oggi, scritta e diretta da Rolando Ravello. Durante la ricreazione nel cortile di una scuola elementare, nel periodo di Natale, un bambino musulmano rompe una finestra con una pietra e ferisce lievemente un bidello. Il piccolo incidente innesca una serie di colpi di scena e reazioni inaspettate in un dibattito che coinvolgerà docenti, alunni e parenti. Tratto dall’opera teatrale di Stefano Massini. Rolando Ravello è stato fra gli sceneggiatori del fortunatissimo "Perfetti sconosciuti".

programme.title: Scordato
programme.desc: Deliziosa commedia di Rocco Papaleo, anche protagonista accanto a Giorgia. Un accordatore di pianoforti si scopre affetto da una contrattura 'emotiva'.

programme.title: Maggie Moore(s) - Un omicidio di troppo
programme.desc: Commedia a tinte gialle targata Sky Original con Jon Hamm e Tina Fey. In una polverosa citta' dell'Arizona, il capo della polizia si trova alle prese con gli omicidi di due donne omonime.

programme.title: Poveri ma ricchissimi
programme.desc: Fausto Brizzi dirige Christian De Sica ed Enrico Brignano nel sequel di "Poveri ma ricchi". I Tucci entrano in politica e indicono un referendum per sancire l'indipendenza del loro borgo.

programme.title: Febbre da cavallo - La mandrakata
programme.desc: Carlo Vanzina dirige Gigi Proietti ed Enrico Montesano nel sequel del cult degli anni 70. Ancora accanito scommettitore, Mandrake coinvolge un gruppo di buffi complici in una truffa.
